summary: Planet Green Holdings Corp. filed a prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $8,922,860 of its common stock. The ATM Sales Agreement dated July 13, 2026 appoints Curvature Securities, LLC as sole sales agent at a 3.0% commission rate. Shares will be sold on NYSE American at prevailing market prices. This is a routine capital-raising ATM program, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition or restructuring. The filing enables discretionary equity sales; no specific price, premium, or timetable is set. Investors should monitor actual sales volume and dilution impact.
